text:
lina: Noticed an uptick in SCIM 403s after yesterday's role rename (analytics_power -> analytics_team). Error rate ~0.7% of provision calls since 04:10 UTC.

marco: logs show KMS Decrypt failures with `InvalidEncryptionContext` for external_id blobs. looks like the encryption context includes `role=analytics_power` which no longer matches the current role tag.

rachel: confirming the rotation run updated the live context for new writes, but we missed backfilling existing encrypted external_ids.

lina: example log: 
```
2026-03-20T04:11:02Z scim-worker ERROR org=beta-corp user=svc-ingest-7 err=InvalidEncryptionContext details="key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/redwood-kms ctx={role:analytics_power, env:prod}"
```

marco: Severity P2. Affected: service accounts for CI/CD and a handful of user invites. Impact: transient permissions gaps (403) until provisioning succeeds.

rachel: remediation options: 
- bulk re-encrypt (decrypt with old context -> encrypt with new), or
- modify provisioner to accept both contexts during a transition window (read-time fallback), or
- revert the role rename (not preferred).

lina: preference is dual-read fallback + audit + scheduled backfill. dual-read will reduce customer impact immediately.

marco: dual-read approach details: provisioner should try decrypt with current key/context, if fails try decrypt with legacy context(s) and if successful re-encrypt and write back (async). set a processing flag to avoid race conditions. emit audit event for each re-encryption.

rachel: security asks for immutable audit entries: include subject=external_id, id, old_ctx, new_ctx, actor=service:scim-migration, request_id. push to audit-stream with high redundancy.

lina: pre-checks before any bulk ops: 
1) verify old key version still exists and has Decrypt permission for migration principal.
2) snapshot count of affected rows and take DB backup.
3) test path in staging with a small sample.

marco: ran a quick staging probe: out of 12k external_ids, 880 matched legacy ctx. decryption success 100% against archived key.

rachel: edge-case: some records were created during the brief window where the app wrote the new role tag but an older deploy stamped the legacy ctx. those might already be double-marked; migration job should dedupe (idempotency token) to avoid double writes.

ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled maintenance window requested for 2026-03-20T23:30:00Z - 23:45:00Z for SCIM backfill. Pager duty will be alerted.

lina: migration plan: 
- implement dual-read in provisioner (fast rollback possible) [marco, due +2h]
- create re-encrypt batch job with transactional per-record swap + audit emission [marco + rachel, due +6h]
- run staging dry-run and confirm counts [rachel, due +1h]
- schedule prod window with SRE and notify customers [lina, due +3h]

marco: implementation notes: keep batch size small (300) and a 500ms sleep between batches; use idempotency key `scim_reencrypt_v1:<id>`; write `reencrypted_at` and `reencrypted_by` fields. if any decryption fails with both contexts, escalate and abort.

rachel: add QA: run `SELECT COUNT(1) FROM external_ids WHERE reenrypted_at IS NULL AND created_at < '2026-03-20'` after job to validate. also run a sampling check: decrypt a random 200 records and confirm mapping.

sre-oncall: we'll watch error budget and latency during the window. set an alert for >1% provisioning error rate. if escalation needed, page SRE.

lina: vulnerability note: should check why role rename got out-of-sync with stored ctx. risk: if any automation writes encrypted blobs with stale ctx in future, we'll reintroduce this. follow-up: add a gating check to the RBAC rename runbook to run a scanner for dependent encrypted blobs.

marco: also add infra control: when rotating keys or renaming roles, write a migration plan step that either updates stored contexts or keeps backward-compatibility window. ticket created: ENGSEC-2147.

rachel: staging dry-run: 880 affected, sample decrypt ok, planning prod run tonight in the reserved window. posting dry-run logs to the incident doc.

lina: good work. keep the audit events flowing and post final counts here after prod. we'll close incident when audit confirms zero legacy ctx remaining. :white_check_mark:
